source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8 (PDF 222), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Innovation (nayi soch se behtari) aur creativity (naye ideas sochne ki salahiyat) aisi zaroori skills hain jo hamari duniya mein taraqqi aur behtari laati hain. In mein aam soch se hat kar sochna (thinking outside the box), naye ideas lana aur masail ke unique (sab se alag) hal dhoondna shamil hai. Is hisse mein hum dekhenge ke innovation aur creativity ka matlab kya hai, yeh kyun aham hain aur rozmarra zindagi mein, khaas taur par Pakistan mein, inhein kaise istemal kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Innovation aur creativity ka aapas mein kya taluq hai?
blocks.explanation: Creativity naye ideas paida karti hai; innovation un ideas ko naye ya behtar products, services ya tareeqon mein badal deti hai.

items: Creativity naye ideas banati hai; innovation un ideas ko naye ya behtar products aur tareeqon mein badalti hai.
